Known for their sturdy construction and culinary versatility, these griddles transform meal prep into a social event, making gatherings memorable. Whether camping and cooking breakfast with nature's backdrop or dinner under the stars, Blackstone griddles are a central fixture in outdoor cooking setups. Innovative Design for Peak Performance Blackstone griddles are celebrated for their innovative designs that elevate the unparalleled versatility of gas griddles known across the culinary world. One standout feature is the patented rear grease management system. This true engineering marvel minimizes cleanup time, allowing you to focus on savoring delicious meals and cherishing the company around you. This peak performance hallmark comes in various sizes, offering an extensive scope of dishes that span from hearty breakfasts and decadent lunches to exquisite dinners and effortlessly circling back to scrumptious morning meals. Imagine crafting a delightful spread of pancakes, golden French toast, eggs done to perfection, crisp bacon, enticing stir fry, and brilliantly caramelized steaks and burgers that tantalize your taste buds, not to forget perfectly seared sausages and succulent chicken. The true beauty lies in the ability to prepare the entire feast on your Blackstone griddle cooking station, exuding style, and culinary prowess as you do so. Whether enhancing a simple breakfast or orchestrating a grand dinner, the Blackstone griddle transforms meal preparation into art, making every gathering memorable. Solid Steel, Durable Construction That's Built to Last Blackstone flattop grills offer incredible durability, and their outstanding design is evidence of that. Each grill features a powder-coated steel exterior that fights off rust and withstands the rigors of outdoor elements, ensuring your investment retains its value over time. The heavy-duty, 7-gauge steel cooktop offers excellent heat distribution, allowing for consistent cooking results with every use, whether you're frying eggs or sizzling steaks. To further safeguard this robust equipment, Blackstone offers durable, weather-resistant covers that protect your grill from harsh weather conditions, preventing damage and prolonging the griddle's life. Additionally, specialized branded tool sets are available, enabling users to elevate their griddle experience and maintain its peak performance. It’s hardly surprising then that Blackstone is one of the USA's leading griddle manufacturers. Whether you envision a delicious breakfast spread or a luxurious evening barbecue, turning these dreams into reality is just a phone call away by dialing 1-855-332-1477 or conveniently placing an order online with a few clicks. Blackstone Grills FAQ Do Blackstone grills use a lot of propane? The Blackstone cooking surface is very dense steel and requires a lot of energy to reach cooking temperatures. A large Blackstone griddle can go through a 1 lb propane tank in less than an hour. We recommend using 20 lb propane tanks whenever possible to make sure you have enough fuel. How long do Blackstone griddles last? With proper care and maintenance, a Blackstone griddle should provide you with a couple of decades of service! We recommend cleaning the griddle after each use, replacing any parts that may wear out, and using a cover for your griddle when not in use. In addition, if you shut down your griddle for winter, store it inside if possible. What is so great about a Blackstone grill? Blackstone makes durable, affordable, innovative griddles that last. The cooking surfaces are solid steel. They offer a wide variety of products in different sizes for various uses, and customers rate them highly. Can you grill on a Blackstone griddle? That depends on your definition of "grill." Blackstone griddles have a solid steel flat top cooking surface, which doesn't allow for open-flame grilling or broiling. That said, Blackstone griddles are fantastic for cooking for groups, and offer a very social grilling experience. Can Blackstone griddle be used indoors? No. Blackstone grills are designed for outdoor cooking only and even with good ventilation are not appropriate for indoor use. Are Blackstone grills expensive? Blackstone griddles range in price from under $200 to over $1,200, with pricing based on size, feature set, and other factors. Blackstone offers models for every budget.
